rationale: The Lofi Version exists but belongs to 'Laufey Lofi Collection' by Mei Mei The Bunny (Laufey as lead vocalist/composer), an EP released 2024 per Qobuz/Deezer/Presto — not an album titled 'Laufey' (2023). | sources: https://www.qobuz.com/ie-en/album/laufey-lofi-collection-mei-mei-the-bunny/bn4lxdo39v1ma, https://www.deezer.com/us/album/616495791
